summary: This report recommends that City Council deny the request for a permit to remove one (1) privately owned tree located at 118 Withrow Avenue. The application indicates the reasons for removal are to address concerns that the tree is too close to the house, the risk of damage to the property from tree roots and that the tree is too large for the property. The subject tree is a silver maple (Acer saccharinum), measuring 80 cm in diameter. The Private Tree By-law does not support the removal of this tree as it is healthy and maintainable.
decided: City Council on April 24, 25, 26 and 27, 2018, adopted the following: 1. City Council deny the request for a permit to remove one (1) privately owned tree located at 118 Withrow Avenue.
